audience.programmeDescription: Global Law at Tilburg University studies legal problems across jurisdictions through comparative, public, private and international law. Legal history, philosophy, research and communication support a broad legal foundation and a required bachelor thesis.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The UCR options combine substantive comparative and international legal study with political and social contexts, commercial fields, or environmental governance. They retain gaps in Tilburg’s sustained doctrinal and legal-skills sequence and required legal thesis. Shared rows show partial subject relationships rather than course equivalence or professional qualification.
